text: I would not intend any reflection on Timoleon, for accepting of a house and handsome estate in the country, which the Syracusans presented him with; there is no dishonor in accepting; but yet there is greater glory in a refusal, and the supremest virtue is shown in not wanting what it might fairly take.
author: Plutarch
locator: Comparison of Timoleon with Aemilius Paulus
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
